standard_prerequisites.name: The base-change tensor lemma computes the derived pushforward of a derived tensor as the derived tensor with the derived pushforward of the other factor, with perfectness and base-change stability
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the machinery for both parts.

core_obligations: Part (1): apply the base-change tensor lemma with the complex G^bullet = O_X in degree 0, so that E tensor O_X = E and Rf_*E is perfect and commutes with base change (proof lines 7756-7758).
Part (2): apply the base-change tensor lemma with E = O_X and G^bullet = G in degree 0, so that Rf_*G = Rf_*O_X tensor G is perfect and commutes with base change (proof lines 7758-7760).
proof_roadmap: Instantiate the base-change tensor lemma for part (1) (proof lines 7756-7758).
